description: Illustrative aging-based collection-loss estimate. Not calibrated to a real clinic or a statutory reporting framework. No source invoices or payments are altered.
age_basis: Calendar days since completed service; no contractual payment due dates are available. Aging does not prove delinquency.
recognition: Main profit = completed-service revenue minus recorded operating costs, before estimated collection losses. A separate what-if scenario deducts the monthly change in an assumed loss allowance. It is not a booked loss or cash payment.
scope: Modeled operating ledger only. Zero opening tracked receivables, payables and allowance on January 1, 2024. No opening bank balance, capital purchases, debt, taxes, owner distributions or pre-2024 ledger. Cash surplus is not total bank cash or owner take-home pay. Depreciation is noncash.
